item.title: No 10 considers extending under-25s benefits overhaul to older groups
item.body: Downing Street is considering whether plans to replace key disability benefits for under-25s with work and training should be extended to older age groups, according to the Guardian. The move risks reigniting Labour tensions over welfare changes.

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | 🏛️ No 10 considers extending under-25s benefits overhaul to older groups

Downing Street is considering whether plans to replace key disability benefits for under-25s with work and training should be extended to older age groups, according to the Guardian. The move risks reigniting Labour tensions over welfare changes.

Source: Guardian | Image: Pixabay
UK Daily Briefing | 13 November, 17:50
